purpose: User-requested exploratory short-leg extension; reuse audited forecasts without retraining or selecting a winning allocation
execution: Freeze units and 1% ADV share caps at signal close; execute at next close, cancel missing fills without reranking; one continuous signed-position cash account
ranking: Long highest predicted returns; short lowest predicted returns, not realized future losers. Same K per side. Fractional boundary ties net overlapping exposures; require at least 2K eligible names for short portfolios.
borrow: Assumed annual rate on prior-close short notional, calendar days / 365, including weekends; no historical locate/recall or per-security fee evidence
financing: Zero cash interest and zero short-proceeds rebate, matching existing zero-interest controls; no additional borrowing of cash, no modeled forced margin liquidations
prices: Signed positions in the existing adjusted economic-price series, a total-return proxy. Dividend effects are implicit in signed price changes; do not add another dividend debit. These are synthetic adjusted-price units, not a broker execution replay.
settlements: Signed cash/share consideration at reviewed completion close; stock consideration immediately liquidated with symmetric costs; existing acquisition timing approximation retained
comparability: Keep long100 parent curves unchanged. Include 75% and 50% long-only plus zero-interest cash controls to distinguish short-leg value from merely reducing long exposure.
uncertainty: All configurations disclosed; five-seed individual short portfolios plus ensembles. Paired 20-session circular bootstrap, 1000 replicates, exploratory and not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
limitations: Dollar-neutral targets are not beta/sector neutral and drift between five-session rebalances. Assumed short availability, missing recalls, margin rules, execution restrictions and variable financing prevent claims of executable historical profitability. 2022-2025 is previously inspected research data.
